name: Catherine
description: Blocks 2 enemies; Can use <Support Devices> in battles

candidates.name: Directional Support Signal
candidates.description: Carries 2 Support Devices (max 2 deployed at once) that grant an Operator a <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> equal to 10% of Catherine's Max HP (if target has not received an attack within 5s, <$ba.barrier>Barrier</> replenishes by 6% of Catherine's Max HP every second, cannot go over the starting limit); effects from Devices do not stack
